question: 'Mahamastakabhishek' is a ______ festival celebrated every twelve years.
solution:
The correct answer is __** Jain.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• ** Mahamastakabhishek is a major festival of Jains that is celebrated once in every twelve years.**

 
 
• This festival is celebrated to mark the consecration of the statue of Lord Bahubali, who was the son of the first Tirthankara, Rishabhdev. 
 
• The festival is celebrated with great enthusiasm and devotion by Jains all over the world.
 
 
 
• Sikh: Sikhism does not celebrate Mahamastakabhishek as it is a festival of Jainism.
 
• Buddhist: Buddhism also does not celebrate this festival as it is specific to Jainism.
 
• Hindu: Although Hindus have many festivals, Mahamastakabhishek is not a Hindu festival but a Jain one.
